notes.title: Street Tuning Evolution
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25874778/c8bdde78db2c0febe27a1608da1a557a3353e375.jpg[/img]

Wondering how the new Street Legal game might look like? Then, Street Tuning Evolution is exactly what you're looking for. The game is currently in development and it's using Unreal Engine 4 with NVIDIA PhysX for vehicle physics.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25874778/8b9ae43be4a6ac0006a23dc354b21d328fbc5471.png[/img]

Assembly your vehicles, tune, paint or repair parts and race against other players in a multiplayer mode!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25874778/532c5a4b82b668810c31a7da531ca6c9f77e19ce.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25874778/f2db6e33e8500c90f58eb7f3242afe1583886ec8.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25874778/2debb3b3464ccc11305cabb48fcda9a5fb5210e2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25874778/75920190cc834cbbceaffd61d8a4723520e8994f.jpg[/img]

[h1]PROJECT NEEDS YOUR SUPPORT[/h1]

There's an important thing about this game. We're a small group of people and there's no any big publisher or investor behind us, so we're working on this independently and rely exclusively on the revenues of other projects. There won't be any other Kickstarter campaign this time, so if you really like Street Legal and want this new game to live as long as possible, please, do one of these things:
[list]
[*]If you have bought all our products, add Street Tuning Evolution to your wishlist when we'll release its store page on Steam. If you don't want to buy anything at all, please, add our other products to your wishlist. This action is 
absolutely safe and it won't charge any money from your account

[*]Purchase High Quality Cars Pack DLC or our DeepWeb game that will come out on Sep. 20th

[*]If you're making music, sounds, 3D models, materials, textures or other assets and willing to help us, you can submit your content to Street Tuning Evolution
[/list]

We'll make a special announcement when a Steam store page for this game will be released. Thank you for reading this long message!

notes.title: Cross Racing Championship is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25874778/9705717fd909b5e7a6c3de75ce7aeb66ab95b224.jpg[/img]

[h1]The legendary CRC is here on Steam now![/h1]

It's a racing game that was released by Invictus after Street Legal Racing: Redline back in 2005 and it's using an improved version of Invictus Game Engine, so you can find a lot of familiar things when making mods for it.

We're glad to be an important part of this release and I'd like to say huge thanks to Adrian 'Silent' Zdanowicz for all his hard work that he has done on improving the game!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/925550/Cross_Racing_Championship_Extreme/]Steam store page of Cross Racing Championship Extreme[/url]

notes.title: Build 936
notes.content:
We're sorry for being away for a very long time. Many people started to think that the game got abandoned, but that's not true!

It's a small update today, but more to come soon.

- No more "Invalid wear!" crash

- SteamCloud support

- Fixed memory leaks in ground physics, slightly better stability

- Proper names for all opponents

- Replaced some background mp3's

It also includes a workaround for the "falling through the ground" issue. If you're falling down even after this update, let us know in the comments, but pay attention to the build date on the top of your game window, it must say "Sep 17 2018". Many thanks to Adrian 'Silent' Zdanowicz for working very hard on that issue!

There's a one more thing again. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Workshop uploader
notes.content:
We have released the new version of workshop uploader for Street Legal Racing: Redline. Now it has 4 modes for working with workshop:

1. "Create": allows you to upload new items to workshop

2. "Modify": edit previously published workshop items

3. "Delete": delete items

4. "Info": list your published items

You can read an updated documentation for this utility [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=787893247]HERE[/url]

And this update also includes the new build 935 with few minor improvements:

 - No more "MSVCP140.dll" errors on Windows 7

 - Less memory leaks in resource engine, better stability

 - Game could move you to the garage after exiting freeride mode

 - Cheats and inputs will work if your default keyboard layout is not english

 - No more corrupted images in screenshots folder

 - Vehicles could suddenly fall through the ground in the city, that must not happen now

notes.title: Build 934
notes.content:
We keep working on Street Legal Racing: Redline and here's what we got in this new build:

 - Fixed minor interface bugs on Test Track

 - Improved SteamAPI support (Steam achievements should not glitch anymore)

 - DLC support

 - Fixed crash with "Negative array index" error in car lot

 - High-quality meshes for 21 mufflers (thanks to Green2989)

 - High-quality textures for headlight lens effects and rays

 - New lens effect texture for light stamps

 - New decal textures by VellonGamer

 - Some opponent names have been replaced

 - Added dark tail lights for all stock vehicles (thanks to ramrom for them!)

 - Added missing reflections for Duhen Axis and Duhen Coyot tail lights (by ramrom)

 - Improved meshes for Shimutshibu ST9 and Baiern Yotta tail lights (by ramrom)

 - Improved tail light glow scripts for Hauler's Badge, Duhen Coyot, Einvagen Remo, MCA Stallion and Shimutshibu Sunset (by ramrom)

 - Description fixes for Einvagen Codrac and Duhen Coyot tail lights (by ramrom)

 - Added missing paintcan refill option for spray mode in paintbooth

 - Game could load incorrect default paint color when entering paintbooth

If your game crashes after this update, please, try to start new career.

We got one more thing for you. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Build 933
notes.content:
An another update is here:

 - Sometimes the game could ask for a turbocharger when the it's actually not required to be installed

 - Einvagen 100 series has incorrect position of rear wheels

 - Added special boost calculation formula for legacy engine mods

 - New render object for kits in catalog

 - Fixed supercharger boost calculation bug on Vee engines

 - Improved decal quality in paint booth (many thanks to Medek for the new textures!)

 - If there's no car in the garage, kits and some other parts still could be installed to nowhere after clicking on them

 - Improved paintbooth floor texture

 - Duhen SunStrip 1.5, 1.8 and 2.2 front shock absorbers were missing from catalog

 - Duhen SunStrip 2.2 rear shock absorbers have incorrect damping

 - Default visibility flag for workshop uploader has been changed to "private", this should reduce amount of garbage mods and items that were uploaded by accident

 - Fixed sideskirt texture for Baiern chassis (many thanks to ramrom for this!)

 - Stock Baiern CoupeSport now comes without sideskirts

 - Baiern sideskirts moved to aftermarket parts

 - Two additional kits for Baiern in catalog

 - More launch options

 - Partial code refactoring for better stability

 - Red Flames vehicles could appear in ROC garage

 - Fixed corrupted interface in ROC garage

This build has 4 launch options:

1. Standard option

2. Steam Achivements support (if the game will crash on launch, use another option)

3. Fast legacy build (run legacy executable if you have extremely low framerates)

4. Game editor (will launch workshop installer)

Updates may come out less frequently, since we're working very hard on moving the game to the new game engine and preparing to release remakes of 9 original Street Legal Redline cars.

notes.title: Build 932
notes.content:
Build 932 is now available.

 - New rear wing meshes

 - Fixed incorrect positions for all rear wings in the game

 - MCA Kurumma Z3 stock trunk has a wrong name

 - MCA Stallion has no water object

 - Parts of the car can be moved to a greater distance in garage

 - Added ability to refill paint cans when the pigment ends up

 - Some opponent names have been replaced

 - Fixed incorrect steering wheel diameter for Shimutshibu Sunset

 - Vehicle class and engine power are now printed in the garage and being refreshed in a real time

 - Fixed missing shadow casting for all exhaust pipes of Shimutshibu Sunset, Einvagen Teg, Baiern Yotta, MCA Stallion, Shimutshibu ST9, Einvagen Remo, Duhen Ninja, MCA Kurumma, Duhen Coyot, PFAA Naxas, Hauler's Badge, Einvagen Codrac, Duhen Axis and PFAA Whisper

 - Fixed missing shadow casting for all mufflers

 - Improved game fonts

 - The game now says "You lose!" instead of "Holy shit!" after applying cheat codes

 - Refactored code of ghost driver cheat, increases stability

 - Huge work on refactoring the code of body and engine parts

 - Added simulation of multiple turbochargers

 - Improved calculation of turbo boost calculation on Vee engines

 - Simplified car class differentiation, no more "Vehicle class: unknown"

 - Added additional hints and information button to the racing events list

 - Added new test drive option in the garage (appears in the upper left-hand corner after clicking "Test engine and steering" button)

 - Player's prestige could drop down way too fast when holding the "Advance time" button

 - Progress of racing events didn't reset after loading or starting another career

 - Added Roltzy's GUI for resconvert/resdecode (modding_tools\Resource tools\resgui.exe)

 - If you try to leave career mode and select FREERIDE or QUICKRACE in main menu, a notification will pop up and you don't loose your unsaved career progress after pressing these buttons anymore

 - Added "Safe mode" launch option that might help if the game crashes on launch

NOTE: we strongly recommend you to start the new career after this update.

notes.title: Build 931
notes.content:
The new, more stable build 931 is here.

 - Steam trading cards support

 - Returned Steam achievements support

 - Reduced memory leaks, improved stability

 - Fixed bugs in assembly scripts of all PFAA Naxas models

 - PFAA Naxas steering wheel has incorrect diameter

 - Fixed driver position for all PFAA Naxas models

 - Added missing water object to all PFAA Naxas models

 - Tire wear multiplier has been decreased

 - Shimutshibu Sunset E96S right mirror appears in incorrect section of parts catalog

 - Fixed crash in Hot Action Cop gamemode caused by a corrupted Furrano police car

 - Fixed choppy decal update on mouse hover in paint booth

 - Race Of Champions wins count doesn't reset after loading another career

 - New high-resolution texture of Betsy (night drag race lady) by Anathlyst

 - Removed 8-hour time skip button and changed behaviour of a normal 1-hour time skip button, single press: skip one hour; press and hold: keep skipping time in a fast forward mode

notes.title: Build 930
notes.content:
The new build 930 is here.

 - More smooth and realistic acceleration of all cars

 - Fixed critical bug that was resulting in an unrealistic internal damage

 - Vehicle in the garage could return into default position when pressing "Test engine and steering" button

 - Bots in night drag races now stop their cars if player finishes first, so they shouldn't rush into the back on finish line

 - More traffic/pedestrians in rush hours and on business days

 - Car could get stuck while attempting to drive in the garage

 - Red Flames garage now got the second car standing nearby

 - Duhen SunStrip 2.2DVC was equipped with an incorrect exhaust pipe

 - Fixed critical script errors in the code of all stock cars

 - All models of Einvagen Codrac, Einvagen Teg, Duhen Axis, PFAA Naxas, Shimutshibu ST9, MCA Stallion and Hauler's Furrano have incorrect wheels

 - Fixed incorrect wheel positions for all Einvagen Codrac, Duhen Axis, MCA Kurumma, Duhen Ninja, PFAA Naxas, Einvagen Remo, Einvagen Teg, Shimutshibu ST9, MCA Stallion, Shimutshibu Sunset, Baiern Yotta and Hauler's Furrano models

 - Fix errors in wheel kit scripts that may lead to random crashes in the game

 - Fixed chassis tilt for all Hauler's Badge models

 - Partial refactoring of Chassis.class, better implementation of detecting police siren on the car, removed useless imports

 - Einvagen Remo could come equipped with an incompletely assembled engine

 - Einvagen Teg has too many slots for N2O canisters

 - Added more slots for N2O canisters on Ishima Zed

We had to replace a lot of files once again, so if the game will crash after this update, delete all files in your game folder, reinstall it in Steam and start new career.

notes.title: Build 929
notes.content:
This build changes the look of Valo City.

 - Fixed incorrect boost calculation for V6 and V10 turbochargers

 - MCA Kurumma Z35C and MCA Stallion 3.5 Turbo have incorrect left exhaust header on their stock engines

 - Duhen SunStrip 1.8DVC could appear with an incompletely built engine

 - V6 bi-turbocharger was overpriced

 - Increased the size of invisible collider on ROC track

 - ROC prize dialog could display incorrect information about prize vehicle

 - Fixed bug when moved parts were reverting their positions after repair

 - Completely new, high-detailed traffic and police cars (many thanks to mihon for them!)

 - New light stamps, trash bins, traffic light meshes (by mihon)

 - Light posts cast shadows and can be demolished now (once again, thanks to mihon!)

 - New high-resolution road, pavement and grass textures

 - Car could begin randomly moving sideways in the garage

 - Tail lights don't cast light rays in daytime anymore

We have modified a lot of files, so if your game crashes after this update, please, uninstall the game, delete all game files, install it again and start new career. Framerate may drop down, because the details of traffic, light posts, trees and some other objects was increased, we will strive to improve performance in future builds. Thank you for your great patience!

notes.title: Build 928
notes.content:
Build 928 is here.

 - Fixed System.NullReferenceException that may appear after launch of workshop installer

 - Improved performance in fullscreen mode

 - Minor sound fixes in garage, paint booth and catalog

 - Finished performance systems for inline-6 engine

 - Added turbo exhaust pipe for Baiern CoupeSport/DevilSport

 - Added turbo exhaust pipe for Emer Nonus

 - Fixed incorrect error messages for V12 turbochargers

 - Fixed incorrect model identifiers for all stock cars

 - Improved turbocharger efficiency calculation

 - Ishima WRZ turbocharger has an adjustable wastegate, while the description says it has not

 - Extended engine bay size of Emer Nonus Street GT/MotorSport GT2 chassis

 - Added Baiern Devils 6SFi 3.6 turbocharged and twin-turbocharged engine kits

 - Car is now driveable in the garage

 - Trunk and doors of Emer Nonus Street GT/MotorSport GT2 were getting too far from chassis when opening

 - Added moveable parts interface, allows to adjust position and rotation of selected part

 - Yotta stock models are now equipped with turbochargers

 - Fixed incorrect stock engine parts for all cars

 - Fixed incorrect description of Duhen Ninja TurboHatch chassis

 - Ishima IshiBox 2.0 engine could be supplied with an incorrect Baiern Kraftwerk 2.5 flywheel

 - Shimutshibu ST9 Fusion chassis has a wrong description

 - Fixed wrong muffler position of Shimutshibu ST9 stock exhaust pipe

 - Added turbo exhaust pipe for Shimutshibu ST9

 - Einvagen Codrac custom front bumper has a wrong texture producing dark spots on the top

 - Einvagen supercharged engine could start without supercharger drive belt and supercharger air out pipe

 - Fixed dangerous errors in Einvagen PerPro GTA engine scripts

 - Removed incorrect title "Baiern Kraftwerk 2.5" from inline-4 fuel rail

 - Mouse cursor was not changing when dragging parts in tuning mode

 - Modern rear wing doesn't really fit Prime DLH700, so now this model appears without it

 - Hood and doors of Prime DLH were getting too far from chassis when opening

 - Added texture mapping and paintability to Prime DLH700 mirrors

 - Fixed incorrect click shape and position of V10 bi-turbocharger air out pipe

 - Fixed camera update bug in video options

 - Added the new launch option, so you can run Workshop Installer right from Steam shortcut now

IMPORTANT NOTES:

 - If your game keeps crashing after this update, uninstall it, delete ALL files in game folder, install it from Steam again and start new career

 - "Buyer's remorse" and some other mods may not work after this update, too many files have been modified

 - Multiplayer is not available yet, we're still testing our central servers and strive to make a better final product. Thank you for your patience

 - Loading screens could disappear a bit weird, we have changed their behavior to save the game from freezing. This will be improved in the future

 - Multiple turbos may give incorrect boost, it's a bug and we're working to make a fix

 - If cars are accelerating too fast on your computer, you may try running beta build (second option if running the game from Steam shortcut)

Thanks to everyone who keeps supporting this amazing game! We work very hard to make it better.

notes.title: Attention to modders
notes.content:
This information is very important for everyone who has uploaded mods to Street Legal workshop.

When you're preparing your mod for uploading, you must keep directory structure of the game.

[h1]EXAMPLE[/h1]
You're adding a car that consists of the following files and directories:

[DIR] Audi_TT_2006
[FILE] Audi_TT_2006.rpk

The game will recognize this car only if folder Audi_TT_2006 and 
file Audi_TT_2006.rpk will be placed in cars/racers directory. The file structure will look like this:

[DIR] cars/racers/Audi_TT_2006
[FILE] cars/racers/Audi_TT_2006.rpk

Now imagine that there's an automatic tool that will not read the instruction and just copy the files right into the game folder. Of course, this car will not work after that. To avoid this situation, you need to recreate folder structure like your mod is already installed into the game and copy it to content folder of workshop uploader.

If your mod is replacing original game files, it's ok, installation tool will leave their backups. Just put them into right folders, otherwise they will not work after installation.

[h1]WARNING[/h1]
We will review all existing workshop items to check if they're compatible with our installation tool. If you'll receive a message from Valve with something like "your workshop item is banned", don't panic, we have to mark incompatible items as banned for making them invisible for the installer. After an item got banned, you'll need to modify its folder structure and reupload it to Steam again.

Installation tool will become available in build 926.

notes.title: Important update
notes.content:
We have finally announced an important upgrade to build 917.

- Improved code of game initialization and options menu
- Fixed random behavior of hidden settings menu
- Fixed random switching to 640x480 resolution in fullscreen mode after accessing options menu
- Improved blower hood mesh for Hauler's Badge (thanks to ramrom for that)
- Fixed incorrect names of some tuner parts for Stallion (thanks to ramrom)

== WARNING! YOUR OLD SAVEGAME WILL BE LOST AFTER THIS UPDATE. IF YOU TRY TO LOAD IT, GAME WILL CRASH. ==

In order to fix the issues with saving game settings, we had to modify the structure of savegame files. For safe transition to build 917 follow the instructions below:

1. Delete all old careers and start new one;
2. If the game won't start or if it shows "Create hw 3d device FAILED", uninstall it from Steam (right-click on the game, select "Delete local content", then go to game folder and delete ALL files from there, install the game again)
3. If neither of steps above help, contact support@image-code.com for help.

If you want to enable cheats, to the following:

1. Go to your game folder (usually located at Program Files\Steam\steamapps\common\Street Legal Racing Redline v2.3.1)
2. Open file Player.java in sl\scripts\game\src\
3. Look for these lines of code:

[code]
int		c_enabled	= 0; //defines if player has access to cheats menu
int		c_garage	= 0; //garage codes: money, car selector, roc teleporter, etc.
int		c_track		= 0; //track cheats: slowmotion, osd on/off, freeze, etc.
int		c_eventlist	= 0; //eventlist stuff: join any race, one-click prize
int		c_catalog	= 0; //show/hide kits in catalog
int		c_autosave	= 1; //automatic career progress save
int		c_ghost		= 0; //no drivers in vehicles
[/code]

Replace with these:

/code]
int		c_enabled	= 1; //defines if player has access to cheats menu
int		c_garage	= 1; //garage codes: money, car selector, roc teleporter, etc.
int		c_track		= 1; //track cheats: slowmotion, osd on/off, freeze, etc.
int		c_eventlist	= 1; //eventlist stuff: join any race, one-click prize
int		c_catalog	= 1; //show/hide kits in catalog
int		c_autosave	= 1; //automatic career progress save
int		c_ghost		= 1; //no drivers in vehicles
[/code]

Save this file, run the game again, START NEW CAREER and save it.

notes.title: Cheats are now available
notes.content:
By many requests, we have unlocked the cheats, you don't need to complete career mode now since it's quite difficult to do with all these random crashes and weird bugs.

IMPORTANT: go to Extras -> Hidden options and check if everything is enabled there. You can disable auto save if you're scared that game will corrupt your savegame file after another crash.

Here's the description of all hidden options:

GARAGE CODES:
Special codes that you type in garage
 - testme (get any car, sometimes crashes when you call it, be careful!)
 - letmeroc (go to ROC immediately)
 - reddevil (go to the red club with 1st position in rating)
 - begformoney (adds $100K of cash)

To use garage codes, just type one of them while being in garage, then click screwdriver button. If nothing happened, the code didn't work.

TRACK CHEATS:
Hotkeys that give you advantages on track or in the city. Keys list:
 - F9 (flying camera for screenshots, use PgUp, PgDown, A, Z, Num+, Num- to control it)
 - Num0 (freeze time)
 - Enter (bullet time, slowmotion)
 - 1 (repair car)
 - 2 (reset car, stop it immediately)

EVENT LIST CHEATS:
Go to Event List menu, select racing event and press R key to bypass requirements and join the event.

KITS IN CATALOG:
Enables engine kits, body kits and suspension kits in catalog. Use these kits to build the cars quickly.

AUTO SAVING:
As it says, this controls automatic career saving in the game.

GHOST DRIVER:
A bit buggy feature. It removes driver from your car to let you make screenshots without him.

Click SAVE to save your settings in hidden options menu.

A bit buggy feature. It removes driver from your car to let you make screenshots without him.

Click SAVE to save your settings in hidden options menu.

notes.title: Minor stability update
notes.content:
We are releasing an urgent update to build 909 that should completely eliminate game crash after exit.

If you're still experiencing this bug, please tell us in the comments to this news post and try to describe what did you do in the game in the last few minutes before closing it.
